"""Native registration plus deterministic modal interaction, without GUI claims."""

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

import bpy

ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("MCAD_ROOT", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "blender_addon"))
from mechanical_cad_blender import assembly_job_ui as ui  # noqa: E402
from mechanical_cad_blender import register, registration, unregister  # noqa: E402

checks = []


def check(condition, label):
    assert condition, label
    checks.append(label)


class Manager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.timers, self.operators = [], []

    def event_timer_add(self, interval, window):
        timer = object()
        self.timers.append(timer)
        return timer

    def event_timer_remove(self, timer):
        self.timers.remove(timer)

    def modal_handler_add(self, operator):
        self.operators.append(operator)


class Workspace:
    text = None

    def status_text_set(self, value):
        self.text = value


class Pending:
    done = False
    cancelled = False


class Subject(ui.AssemblyJobMixin):
    def __init__(self):
        self.messages = []

    def report(self, kinds, text):
        self.messages.append((kinds, text))


class Layout:
    def __init__(self):
        self.texts = []

    def label(self, *, text, **kwargs):
        self.texts.append(text)


register()
manager, workspace = Manager(), Workspace()
context = SimpleNamespace(
    window_manager=manager,
    window=bpy.context.window,
    workspace=workspace,
    scene=bpy.context.scene,
)
context.scene.mechanical_cad_assembly.verification_message = "Current measured result"
requested = []


def prepare(*args, **kwargs):
    requested.append((args, kwargs))
    return Pending()


def cancel(pending, reason="cancelled"):
    pending.cancelled = True
    return True


with (
    patch.object(ui.assembly_pending, "prepare", prepare),
    patch.object(ui.assembly_pending, "cancel", cancel),
    patch.object(ui.assembly_pending, "poll", return_value=None) as poll,
    patch.object(ui.assembly_pending, "cancel_all", return_value=True),
):
    subject = Subject()
    check(subject.begin_job(context, "assembly_check") == {"RUNNING_MODAL"}, "start is modal")
    check(len(manager.timers) == 1 and subject in ui._OPERATORS, "one tracked modal timer")
    check("Esc" in workspace.text, "running status explains cancellation")
    check(
        subject.modal(context, SimpleNamespace(type="MIDDLEMOUSE", value="PRESS"))
        == {"PASS_THROUGH"},
        "viewport navigation passes through",
    )
    check(not poll.called, "navigation never consumes evidence")
    check(
        subject.modal(context, SimpleNamespace(type="ESC", value="PRESS")) == {"RUNNING_MODAL"},
        "Escape requests cancellation without blocking cleanup",
    )
    check(subject._pending.cancelled and manager.timers, "cancel retains timer until reaped")
    from mechanical_cad_blender.bridge import BridgeError

    poll.side_effect = BridgeError("Cancelled; prior evidence retained")
    subject._pending.done = True
    check(
        subject.modal(context, SimpleNamespace(type="TIMER", value="NOTHING")) == {"CANCELLED"},
        "reaped cancellation closes modal",
    )
    check(not manager.timers and not ui._OPERATORS, "cancel removes timers and operator tracking")
    check(workspace.text is None, "cancel restores workspace status")
    subject._cleanup_ui()
    check(not manager.timers, "UI cleanup is idempotent")
    for event_type in ("ESC", "TIMER", "MIDDLEMOUSE"):
        calls = poll.call_count
        check(
            subject.modal(context, SimpleNamespace(type=event_type, value="PRESS"))
            == {"CANCELLED"},
            "retired handler terminates every late event",
        )
        check(poll.call_count == calls, "retired handler never accesses pending/RNA")

    poll.side_effect = None
    poll.return_value = {"ok": True}
    subject = Subject()
    check(
        subject.begin_job(context, "assembly_sample", joint_id="slide", values=[1, 2])
        == {"RUNNING_MODAL"},
        "sample uses the same modal lifecycle",
    )
    check(requested[-1][1]["values"] == [1, 2], "exact listed values passed to pending boundary")
    check(
        subject.modal(context, SimpleNamespace(type="TIMER", value="NOTHING")) == {"FINISHED"},
        "published result ends modal successfully",
    )
    check(not manager.timers and not ui._OPERATORS, "success removes timer and tracking")
    check(
        subject.messages[-1][1] == "Current measured result",
        "success uses canonical evidence notice",
    )
    ui.cancel_all("test cleanup")
    check(not bpy.app.timers.is_registered(ui._supervise), "lifecycle removes supervisor")

with patch.object(ui.assembly_pending, "cancel_all", return_value=False):
    check(not ui.cancel_all("delayed cleanup"), "pending OS cleanup remains explicit")
    check(bpy.app.timers.is_registered(ui._supervise), "delayed cleanup retains supervisor")
with patch.object(ui.assembly_pending, "cancel_all", return_value=True):
    check(ui.cancel_all("cleanup completed"), "completed cleanup is reported")
    check(not bpy.app.timers.is_registered(ui._supervise), "completed cleanup removes supervisor")

# Failure before the modal timer exists must still supervise delayed cleanup.
with (
    patch.object(ui.assembly_pending, "prepare", prepare),
    patch.object(ui.assembly_pending, "cancel", cancel),
    patch.object(ui.assembly_pending, "cancel_all", return_value=False),
    patch.object(manager, "event_timer_add", side_effect=RuntimeError("timer unavailable")),
):
    subject = Subject()
    try:
        subject.begin_job(context, "assembly_check")
    except RuntimeError:
        checks.append("interaction setup failure remains explicit")
    else:
        raise AssertionError("timer setup unexpectedly succeeded")
    check(subject._pending.cancelled, "setup failure cancels native request")
    check(
        bpy.app.timers.is_registered(ui._supervise), "setup failure preserves reaping supervision"
    )
with patch.object(ui.assembly_pending, "cancel_all", return_value=True):
    ui.cancel_all("setup failure test cleanup")

layout = Layout()
fixture = {
    "instances": [{} for _ in range(16)],
    "verification_presets": [],
    "active_verification_preset": None,
}
with patch.object(ui.assembly_state, "read_assembly", return_value=fixture):
    ui.draw_workload(layout, context, 32)
check(
    any("120 pairs × 32 poses" in s for s in layout.texts),
    "requested workload names pair/pose count",
)
check(any("3840" in s for s in layout.texts), "full pair-query workload shown")
check(any("measurements only" in s for s in layout.texts), "absent intent never implies pass")
check(any("Esc" in s for s in layout.texts), "confirmation explains in-flight cancellation")
with patch.object(ui, "cancel_all") as cleanup:
    registration._before_blend_load(None)
    check(cleanup.called, "load-pre cancels before replacing scene data")
with patch.object(ui, "cancel_all") as cleanup:
    registration._before_history_change(None)
    check(cleanup.called, "history-pre cancels before undo changes data")
with patch.object(ui, "cancel_all", return_value=True) as cleanup:
    registration._before_blender_exit(None)
    check(cleanup.called, "native exit cancels owned work before daemon threads stop")
check(registration._before_blender_exit in bpy.app.handlers.exit_pre, "native exit hook registered")
unregister()
check(not bpy.app.timers.is_registered(ui._supervise), "unregister leaves no supervisor")
print("ASSEMBLY_JOB_UI_SMOKE_OK", len(checks))
